

```{r}
#| output: false

# get spotlight indicator for selected topic
spotlight_ind <- spotlight_df |>
  dplyr::slice(i) |>
  dplyr::pull(IndicatorID)

# get topic name
selected_topic <- spotlight_df |>
  dplyr::slice(i) |>
  dplyr::pull(TopicName)

# get indicator data
spotlight_data <- spotlight_df |>
  dplyr::slice(i) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    all_data,
    by = c("IndicatorID", "Sex")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(AreaCode == area_code)

# get chart
chart <- healthtrends:::spotlight_chart(
  spotlight_data,
  spotlight_ind,
  area_name
)

chart_title <- unique(spotlight_data$IndicatorName)

# add sex to title if multiple tiles
if (unique(spotlight_data$multiple_tile)) {
  chart_title <- paste0(
    chart_title,
    ", ",
    stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Sex))
  )
}

# get original number of sexes for selected indicator
n_sex <- healthtrends:::ind_n_sex(spotlight_ind, all_data)

```

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-6 .g-col-lg-4}

```{r}
#| results: "asis"

# Card styling
cat(paste0('<div class="card h-100 bg-light">'))

# Theme title
cat(
  paste0(
    '<h2 class="card-header"><a href="',
    base_url <- config::get(
      value = "base_url",
      config = "production"
    ),
    stringr::str_replace_all(area_name, " ", "_"), '/',
    stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_to_lower(selected_topic), " ", "_"),
    '.html">',
    selected_topic,
    '</a></h2>'
  )
)

# Card styling
cat(paste0('<div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">'))

# Chart title
cat(
  paste0(
    '<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-title" href="',
    base_url <- config::get(
      value = "base_url",
      config = "production"
    ),
    stringr::str_replace_all(area_name, " ", "_"), '/',
    stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_to_lower(selected_topic), " ", "_"),
    '.html" tabindex="-1">',
    chart_title,
    '</a></h3>'
  )
)

# Unit subtitle
if (any(unique(spotlight_data$Unit) == "%")) {
  # don't include unit label %
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<p class="card-subtitle">',
      unique(spotlight_data$ValueType), ", ", area_name, ", ",
      stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Sex)), ", ",
      stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Age)),
      "</p>"
    )
  )
} else if (any(unique(spotlight_data$ValueType) == "Life expectancy")) {
  # don't include value type name to avoid repetition of life expectancy
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<p class="card-subtitle">',
      unique(spotlight_data$Unit), ", ", area_name, ", ",
      stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Sex)), ", ",
      stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Age)),
      "</p>"
    )
  )
} else {
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<p class="card-subtitle">',
      unique(spotlight_data$ValueType), " ", stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Unit)), ", ",
      area_name, ", ", stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Sex)), ", ",
      stringr::str_to_lower(unique(spotlight_data$Age)),
      "</p>"
    )
  )
}

# Chart image
cat(
  paste0(
    '<p><div style="margin-top: auto;">',
    '[![](', chart, ')',
    '{fig-alt="', healthtrends:::dynamic_text(spotlight_data, area_name, n_sex),
    '" tabindex="-1"}]',
    '(/',
    base_url <- config::get(
      value = "base_url",
      config = "production"
    ),
    stringr::str_replace_all(area_name, " ", "_"), '/',
    stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_to_lower(selected_topic), " ", "_"),
    '.html)',
    '</div></p>'
  )
)

# Link to indicators
cat(
  paste0(
    '<a href="',
    base_url <- config::get(
      value = "base_url",
      config = "production"
    ),
    stringr::str_replace_all(area_name, " ", "_"), '/',
    stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_to_lower(selected_topic), " ", "_"),
    '.html" class="card-link" tabindex="-1"> See more ',
    stringr::str_to_lower(selected_topic),
    ' data</a>'
  )
)

# Card styling
cat(paste0("</div></div>"))
```
